skill.summary: Location-aware Valentine's Day gift finder. Routes US users to premium flowers (UrbanStems), Singapore users to wellness supplements (Avea Life). Returns curated picks with Decision Packs — no decision fatigue, just 2-3 perfect options.

latestVersion.changelog: v4.0.0: MAJOR - Added Daniel Wellington watches (182) and Beardbrand men's grooming (67). Now 8 gift categories with 2,099 products across 12 merchants. Full Valentine's gift suite for him & her.
